products.name: Busabase
products.tagline: The general system of record for AI agents
products.description: Different agents. One shared base. Busabase is a general-purpose database and workspace for people and AI agents. Keep business records, docs, skills, and apps in one place so the next task can build on them. Connect Claude Code, Codex, and more. Set access, review changes when needed, and see what changed. Busabase is open source, with Cloud, Personal Desktop, and self-hosting options.

products.name: Zernio
products.tagline: Marketing infrastructure for products and agents
products.description: Zernio is the marketing infrastructure 200,000 developers build products on. We absorb the integrations, platform approvals and maintenance behind every channel, all on official APIs, so you can start building today. One API covers 16 social platforms, ads on 7 networks, WhatsApp, iMessage, and phone numbers with calls and SMS that you buy inside Zernio. Use the REST API in your code, or let your coding agent do the same through our MCP server and CLI.

products.name: Playground by Google Labs
products.tagline: Create, play, and share your own games with Google AI
products.description: Google Playground is an experimental AI gaming platform that lets anyone create, play, and share custom games without coding. Describe your idea, choose a genre, and let AI build a playable game in minutes. Change the rules, characters, physics, or visuals simply by chatting. Share your creation with friends, publish it to the community gallery, or explore games made by others. Powered by Google's Gemini, Nano Banana, and Lyria models.

products.name: Together Link
products.tagline: Use open models in your harness
products.description: Together Link connects coding agents to open models on Together AI, letting developers keep their existing tools and workflows while reducing model costs.

products.name: Odyssey 3
products.tagline: A world model that simulates physics in real time
products.description: Odyssey-3 is a foundation world model that generates interactive environments from a prompt and predicts in real time how they change as you or an agent act in them. Its Pro version posts the highest reported Physics-IQ Verified video-to-video score (66.1, best-of-8). The same model has been adapted to control robot arms and humanoids, drive a car, and train agents. Try the research preview, or get in touch for API access.x`

products.name: Gemini Agent for Google Cloud
products.tagline: The work agent that runs on both Gemini and Claude
products.description: Gemini agent is Google Cloud's single, universal agent for work. Give it an objective, not instructions: it plans, uses your company's skills and tools, connects to Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Salesforce, Jira or any MCP server, and hands back finished docs, decks or code. Unlike chat assistants that stop at an answer, it keeps running in the cloud for hours or days, spins up coworker agents with their own email and calendar, and routes each job to the right model under hard spend caps.

products.name: Staffcoder
products.description: Staffcoder is a hands-on coding platform where developers practice real engineering work instead of algorithm puzzles. Choose from 1000+ challenges across 39 learning paths, covering React, Next.js, Django, Spring Boot, Docker, Kubernetes, AI agents, and more. Every challenge runs in a full browser IDE with a real terminal, file system, and live preview, so there is nothing to install. Pick a stack, open a challenge, and build. Free to start.

products.name: Refs
products.tagline: Give Claude better references for your videos
products.description: Refs is a library of 3000+ films that moved people, each measured cut by cut and written up as a 15-plate blueprint with a recipe prompt. Add it to Claude Code, Codex or Cursor with one command, and Claude plans your launch film from the real thing.

products.name: AgentSDR
products.description: The open-source AI SDR workspace that replaces Clay, Smartlead, HubSpot, and many more. Run email sequences, LinkedIn campaigns, and WhatsApp outreach with built-in data enrichment and automations, backed by an AI CRM that automatically classifies replies and drafts responses. Self-hosted with your own AI keys.

products.name: OpenPilot
products.tagline: Open-source desktop AI agent for any model you choose
products.description: OpenPilot is a free, MIT-licensed desktop AI agent. Connect any OpenAI-compatible model (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio), pick a folder, and it reads and edits files and runs commands there. You approve sensitive actions. Windows now, macOS early beta.

products.name: OpenVids
products.tagline: Open-source video editor you run by chatting with AI agents
products.description: Open-source, agent-first AI video editor for macOS and Windows. Describe the film — agents cut the timeline, add motion and sound, and review the render.

products.name: Pine Computer
products.tagline: A cloud computer built for AI to get jobs done
products.description: Pine Computer is a cloud computer built for AI to use. Your product hands it a job: research, forms, spreadsheets, portals with no API. The finished work comes back. AI reads each app's structure instead of pixels, is told when something changes, and gets as many virtual screens as it needs. Spin up a computer per customer through one SDK, bring your own model or use ours, and let a person take over for sign-ins or approvals. Invite-only beta.

products.name: BrightBean Studio
products.tagline: Open-source Buffer alternative for social media teams
products.description: BrightBean Studio is a free, open-source Buffer alternative for social media teams, agencies and small businesses. Schedule and publish to 10+ platforms, manage approvals, analytics and inboxes, and connect AI agents through the built-in MCP server and REST API.

products.name: OpenCharm
products.tagline: Open-source body for the AI agent you already run
products.description: OpenCharm is an open-source body for the AI agent you already run, right by your Mac's notch. Hold one key to talk and Claude Code, Codex or any agent gets to work, answers out loud and asks when it needs you. Next, it hangs from your keychain.

products.name: Amazon Alexa Tablets
products.tagline: Full Google Play, Alexa+ and a Kindle reading mode
products.description: Amazon Alexa Tablets are a new Android lineup with full Google Play access and Alexa+ built in. Available in 8.7-inch, 11-inch, and 12-inch sizes, they bring on-screen AI assistance, live conversations, a distraction-free Kindle reading mode, and an optional Nanomatte display on the 12 Pro.
